pages.text: [#](53341a)A large Otherwhere working that draws animal life into the circle from far across the countryside — up to a hundred paces and more.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Beastial Call

pages.text: [#](53341a)Less a summoning than a lure: it coaxes creatures to answer a call they do not understand, and they arrive a few at a time over long minutes, not all at once.[#]()
[#](53341a)Be patient, and have beasts within range to call.[#]()
[#](53341a)Offer barn and field bait: a milk bucket, hay bale, apple, beef, cod, red mushroom, carrot, and seeds, plus **6000 altar power**.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)It favors pigs, chickens, cows, sheep, mooshrooms, wolves, and ocelots.[#]()
[#](53341a)**It demands a coven of three.** Three witches or more must keep the circle, or the call goes unanswered and the rite collapses — this is no solitary working.[#]()
[#](53341a)Do not cast it near a village ranch unless you can explain yourself.[#]()
